company.name: MIT CSAIL
aliases: Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory

profile_text.body:
MIT CSAIL, also known as the Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, is a university lab rather than a for-profit company. It is based in Cambridge, MA, USA, and its website is csail.mit.edu. The site's home page identifies it simply as MIT CSAIL.

The record lists no products and no MCP servers for the lab, so there is no product line to describe here.

No lawsuits are listed. The only legal figure on file is a count of 187 in Massachusetts.
